subtitle: Daga cryptographic hash chains zuwa programmable smart contracts: injiniyoyin da suka mai da blockchain platform, ba kawai ledger ba.
excerpt: Blockchain wani append-only ledger ne da aka kare shi da cryptographic hash chains da distributed consensus — tsari wanda ke sa canza bayanan ya zama mai tsada a lissafi kuma ana iya duba shi daga kowa. Ethereum ya faɗaɗa wannan tushe da layer na programmable execution, ya mai da rikodin payments mai sauƙi zuwa platform don smart contracts, tokens, da decentralised finance.
